resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two 1944 newspaper items name different men for the Slate Rock post. The story reports the conflict without naming them.

notes_for_editor: No photos recorded: the register photos are credited to private collections with no license stated. The two 1944 newspaper items name different men for the same post; the story omits names on purpose. The brief's design L-5 is confirmed. No source describes the site today.
